svg.title: The polar frame turns while a constant vector field has zero covariant derivative
svg.desc: Left: the plane with polar coordinate curves; at eight points of the circle r = 2 the polar basis vectors e_r and e_theta turn, while the constant field d/dx stays parallel. Right: the partial derivative of the radial component of that field along the circle, minus sine theta, plus the connection term, plus sine theta, add to zero.
svg.text: The polar frame turns; the constant field does not
circles r = 1, 2, 3. Blue: er. Orange: unit vector along eθ.
Black: the constant field ∂/∂x, the same arrow everywhere.
The covariant derivative of X along eθ, radial part
At r = 2: Γθθr = −r and Xθ = −sin θ / r, so the correction
is +sin θ and cancels the partial derivative exactly.
